issue.body:
Move `TransportGetTransformStatsAction` to the management threadpool, and match `Task` based on java type first before comparing the description to prevent iterating over a large abount of transform ids for tasks that are not `TransformTask`.

Resolve #139252

-----------------------

This pattern copies what we had done for [GetJobsStatsAction](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/core/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/core/ml/action/GetJobsStatsAction.java#L114)

If you commit this change before I return, please change the commit message to say `management threadpool` instead of `generic threadpool` please and thank you :)
